issues.description: The solution implements the toString() method with the signature 'public Object toString()' which does not match the expected Java toString() signature that returns a String. The problem statement explicitly asks for a custom toString() method describing the lecture (implying the standard String return type). The solution also uses the @Override annotation above this method; because the return type is Object instead of String, the method does not correctly override Object.toString() and will cause a compile-time error. This mismatch will confuse students and prevents the solution from compiling.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the toString() method signature in the solution to 'public String toString()' and ensure it returns a String. Keep the @Override annotation so it properly overrides Object.toString(). This will align the solution with the problem statement and allow the code to compile.
